IMPORTANT: Replace soundchat.mp3 with actual audio file

To add notification sound:
1. Download a short notification sound (0.5-2 seconds)
2. Recommended sources:
   - https://notificationsounds.com/notification-sounds
   - https://freesound.org/browse/tags/notification/
   - https://mixkit.co/free-sound-effects/notification/

3. Rename file to soundchat.mp3
4. Place in: steam-launcher/public/soundchat.mp3
5. Delete this placeholder file

Sound format: MP3 (recommended) or WAV
Recommended: Lightweight notification sound under 100KB
